release_name: Live TV v5.1.16 (Build 51) — In-Player Settings Modal & Performance Polish
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🎬 In-Player Playback & Quality Settings: Quality pill ([ 1080p ]) and Audio/Subtitles options now open directly over the active video stream without closing the player
⚡ Seamless Quality Ladder: Switching between Auto, 4K, 1440p, 1080p, 720p, 480p, and Data Saver preserves continuous video playback
❄️ Zero-Heat & Battery Optimization: iOS native AVPlayer hardware fullscreen, 0% idle GPU overhead, and direct Apple Silicon CoreAnimation layer
🛡️ 100% Ad-Free Zero-Ad Shield: Comprehensive popup blocker and ad filter protecting all 2,989 channels
